title: General Foot Stroking
summary: Light palm strokes over the sole and top of the foot.
goal: Warm the foot gently and assess comfort.
instructions: Work the top of the foot very lightly.
direction: From heel toward toes over soft tissue.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
